items.coder_A: XS15 (TLR1/2 ligand) is described as an immunomodulator; coded as vaccine adjuvant (excluded type), but could be argued a pharmacological immune agonist candidate.
items.proposed: XS15 is part of the excluded vaccine; no candidate; trial excluded at S6 as excluded_intervention_type
items.reason: R4 lists XS15 explicitly as an adjuvant that is part of the excluded therapy. The record gives XS15 no arm or outcome of its own: it is 'emulsified in Montanide ISA 51 VG' with the peptides in the single arm 'Multipeptide plus XS15', and the primary efficacy endpoint is vaccine immunogenicity.

note: IDH1-wildtype and MGMT methylation are entry requirements (MGMT counts for any_molecular_selection; IDH-wildtype only defines GBM). target_engagement_planned set to 'no' because there is no candidate (ELISpot immunogenicity is a vaccine endpoint).
